where.title: Where to spray
where.text: Spray from 15-20 cm and don't rub - the notes will unfold evenly.

note.text: Store in a cool, dark place - the fragrance will stay true for longer.

items.title: Open
items.text: Unscrew the cap and remove the stopper.

items.title: Add the reeds
items.text: Place the reeds in the bottle and fan them out.

items.title: Turn them weekly
items.text: Turned reeds soak up the oil again - and the scent grows stronger.

where.title: Where to place it
where.text: Works best in a smaller room, away from draughts and direct sunlight.

note.text: Keep out of reach of children and pets. The oil can damage varnished surfaces - place it on a coaster.

items.title: Longer the first time
items.text: Let it burn until the whole surface has melted - so the candle burns evenly.

items.title: Trim the wick
items.text: Before each burn - to 5 mm. The flame will be calm and smoke-free.

items.title: Up to 4 hours
items.text: Burn for no more than 4 hours at a time and let the wax cool.

note.text: Never leave a burning candle unattended. Keep away from curtains, children and pets.

items.title: Add water
items.text: Fill the diffuser tank up to the line.

items.title: Add the oil
items.text: A few drops are enough - adjust the intensity with the number of drops.

items.title: Switch on
items.text: A soft fragrant mist will spread through the whole room.

note.text: For diffusers only: do not ingest or apply to skin. Keep out of reach of children.

items.title: Add water
items.text: Fill the tank with water up to the line.

items.title: Add the oil
items.text: A few drops of your favourite fragrance oil.

items.title: Switch on
items.text: The diffuser turns water and oil into a soft fragrant mist.

note.title: Care
note.text: Every few uses, rinse the tank with warm water and dry it. Unplug before cleaning.
